messages.content: "Can you tell me how many active players were engaged with the video game 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare' in the year 2019 on the 'Playstation' platform, and then compare that with the number of active players for the same game in the year 2020 on the 'PC' platform? Also, could you provide the sales figures for 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare' for the year 2019 on the 'Playstation' platform and then for the year 2020 on the 'PC' platform?"

function.name: video_games_get_player_count
function.description: Retrieves the number of active players for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

function.name: video_games_get_sales
function.description: Retrieves the sales figures for a specified video game and year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_title.description: The title of the video game.

platform.description: The gaming platform (e.g. 'PC', 'Xbox', 'Playstation'). Default is all if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to call two functions: get player count for each combination; also get sales figures.

First query: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, 2019, Playstation. Then second: same game, 2020 PC.

Then sales: 2019 PlayStation, 2020 PC.

We'll use the tool calls accordingly. We'll do four separate calls or combine into one? We can make multiple calls sequentially. Let's first fetch player counts:

1) video_games_get_player_count({"game_title":"Call of Duty: Modern Warfare","year":2019,"platform":"Playstation"}).

2) video_games_get_player_count({"game_title":"Call of Duty: Modern Warfare","year":2020,"platform":"PC"}).

Similarly sales:

3) video_games_get_sales({"game_title":"Call of Duty: Modern Warfare","year":2019,"platform":"Playstation"}).

4) video_games_get_sales({"game_title":"Call of Duty: Modern Warfare","year":2020,"platform":"PC"}).

Let's proceed.
